title: Jazzy Neapolitan Foie Gras Risotto
description: A peppery, creamy risotto with decadent foie gras, perfect for a brunch mood with Neapolitan flair.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté the minced shallot until translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the Arborio rice, tossing to coat with oil and toasting the edges for about 2 minutes.
Pour in the white wine and stir until it has mostly evaporated, about 3 minutes.
Gradually add the warm vegetable broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly, and wait until each addition is absorbed before adding the next.
When the rice is just shy of al dente, fold in the diced foie gras and continue to stir, allowing the foie gras to gently heat through without overcooking, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pan from heat, stir in butter, grated cheese, black pepper, sea salt, and lemon zest, and adjust seasoning.
Let the risotto rest for 2 minutes, then serve immediately, garnished with a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil.
